name: AnyCraft
description:
Welcome to AnyCraft, a free, public, and semi-vanilla multiplayer Minecraft server available for everyone to play! Please enjoy while respecting other players and properties.

To join AnyCraft, use the following server information,

AnyCraft Server Address (Primary): www.anycraft.org

AnyCraft Server Address (Backup): www.simonyu.net

AnyCraft Server Port (Java Client): 25565

AnyCraft Server Port (Bedrock Client): 19132

Please also join our Discord server at https://discord.gg/qFuVxGqJGp for questions, suggestions, support, reporting disrupting behaviors, etc.
